_comment: UNVERIFIED front faces (+x, +y, -x, -y of the normalised asset frame), read by eye on 9 Nov 2026 from the renders of cloud session 2. The first reading assumed the image labels px, py, nx, ny were the camera sides; a size check on the shelf (native extents 0.51 x 1.51 m) showed the renders lag the camera by one view (the image labelled py shows the +x side, nx the +y side, ny the -x side, px the previous asset's last pose), and the armchair views are inconsistent even with that, so the reading is uncertain. A wrong front turns a piece of furniture around; it does not change its class. Fix before the composed homes are run: render each side with extra updates after the camera move and put a coordinate marker in the frame. dishwasher, kettle, tv, plant (not generator classes) and shower (excluded) are not read.
